author: amit.haski
name: silk-blend-gradient
description: Pure CSS gradient background in the Silk Blend style, made with the 21st.dev Gradient Builder. 3-color palette (#4C6CB3, #B28FCE, #F4B3C2). Features: soft blur finish, film grain, vignette. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections, cards, and page backgrounds.
